title: Rocket Squared
description:
Rocket Squared wanted a confident SaaS presence that could grow with a fast-moving roadmap and shifting feature sets.

We designed modular sections for product storytelling, social proof, and pricing so marketing could ship updates without rebuilding pages.

Engineering handoff included annotated flows and reusable UI blocks aligned with the existing stack.

title: Panda Logo
description:
This engagement centred on a memorable mark that could work across digital, print, and small favicon sizes.

We explored geometry, negative space, and character before locking a system of primary, secondary, and wordmark lockups.

Guidelines cover clear space, colour usage, and misuse cases so partners stay on brand.

title: Motor Control and Power stage Design
description:
A compact and efficient motor controller designed by Haizom Studios for smooth and reliable operation. Built to handle dynamic loads with precision, it delivers consistent performance while maintaining high efficiency.

Engineered with intelligent control techniques, the system ensures accurate speed regulation and stable response under varying conditions. Every detail is optimized for performance, safety, and long-term reliability.

From power handling to control logic, the design focuses on simplicity and effectiveness. The result is a controller that performs seamlessly across a wide range of applications.
